# Adoption dates of Human Rights Council texts, read on 2026-11-10 from OHCHR's session pages
#   https://www.ohchr.org/en/hr-bodies/hrc/regular-sessions/session<N>/res-dec-stat   (N = 12-63; 1-11 have no such page)
# The pages sit behind a browser check, so they were read in a browser and reduced to this file.
# One line per session: <session>|<date>:<texts>;<date>:<texts>...   date "-" = the page gives none,
# "????" = the page gives day and month only. Texts: R<n> = A/HRC/RES/<s>/<n>, D<n> = A/HRC/DEC/<s>/<n>,
# P<n> = A/HRC/PRST/<s>/<n>, L<x> = the not-adopted draft A/HRC/<s>/L.<x>.
# Read as published, typos included (e.g. 37/19 dated 2019, "D2127" in session 27); scripts/parse_marcxml.py
# keeps a date only when it falls inside the session and the page does not contradict itself.
